title: Elliptic L-series reference evaluator
objective: Implement an ordinary-Python complex split-Mellin reference evaluator and focused tests without changing shared public registries

oracles: Sage/PARI lfun values and completed functional equation

handoff.summary: Implemented the ordinary-Python split-Mellin elliptic L-series evaluator, exact coefficient-prefix cache, target-aware resource planner, batched raw/completed values, independent refinement, incomplete-gamma oracle, and a stable native/reference dispatcher. Focused tests cover normalization, functional equation, conjugation, trivial zeros without nearby snapping, native retry/error preservation, resource rejection, 200-bit moderate-height evaluation, and GL64 accuracy through 512 bits.
risks: Quadrature discretization remains non-rigorous by design; diagnostics distinguish refinement from the coefficient, local-grid, and outer-tail bounds.
Full-mpmath reference evaluation is intentionally slow for very large conductors; the Acb native path is the production route for the motivating curve.
Cross-platform validation must be repeated at the exact integration commit after the native bridge and public wrapper are merged.
next_steps: Import CoefficientPrefix into analytic_rank.py so rank and general values share one exact prefix contract.
Wire the public Lseries_ell wrapper to lseries_values using decimal-string point pairs and ComplexField result coercion.
Merge the native _lseries_values_native bridge and run the focused suite against real Acb per-point radii and error diagnostics.
